sql = """-- Top two genres by revenue per billing country for calendar year 2021.
-- InvoiceDate is stored as ISO-8601 text, so a half-open string range is exact.
WITH period_lines AS (
    SELECT
        inv.BillingCountry                                          AS country,
        trk.GenreId                                                 AS genre_id,
        -- round the unit price to whole cents first, then multiply by quantity
        CAST(ROUND(il.UnitPrice * 100) AS INTEGER) * il.Quantity    AS line_cents,
        il.Quantity                                                 AS quantity
    FROM Invoice AS inv
    JOIN InvoiceLine AS il
        ON il.InvoiceId = inv.InvoiceId
    JOIN Track AS trk
        ON trk.TrackId = il.TrackId
    WHERE inv.InvoiceDate >= '2021-01-01'
      AND inv.InvoiceDate <  '2022-01-01'
      AND il.Quantity > 0              -- only lines that actually sold units
),
country_genre AS (
    SELECT
        pl.country,
        pl.genre_id,
        gen.Name                AS genre,
        SUM(pl.line_cents)      AS revenue_cents,
        SUM(pl.quantity)        AS units
    FROM period_lines AS pl
    JOIN Genre AS gen
        ON gen.GenreId = pl.genre_id
    GROUP BY pl.country, pl.genre_id, gen.Name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        cg.country,
        cg.genre_id,
        cg.genre,
        cg.revenue_cents,
        cg.units,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cg.country
            ORDER BY cg.revenue_cents DESC, cg.genre_id ASC
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM country_genre AS cg
)
SELECT
    country,
    CAST(genre_id AS INTEGER)       AS genre_id,
    genre,
    CAST(revenue_cents AS INTEGER)  AS revenue_cents,
    CAST(units AS INTEGER)          AS units,
    CAST(country_rank AS INTEGER)   AS country_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE country_rank <= 2
ORDER BY country ASC, country_rank ASC;
"""
open('/work/query.sql','w').write(sql)
q=open('/work/query.sql').read()
print(len(q.encode()), sqlite3.complete_statement(q))

def run(con):
    steps=[0]
    def h(): steps[0]+=1000; return 0
    con.set_progress_handler(h,1000)
    cur=con.execute(q); rows=cur.fetchall()
    con.set_progress_handler(None,0)
    return [d[0] for d in cur.description], rows, steps[0]
cols,rows,st=run(c)
print(cols, len(rows), 'steps~',st)
for r in rows: print(r)
print({tuple(type(v).__name__ for v in r) for r in rows})

import sqlite3, collections
q=open('/work/query.sql').read()
print(len(q.encode()), sqlite3.complete_statement(q))
def run(con):
    steps=[0]
    def h(): steps[0]+=1000; return 0
    con.set_progress_handler(h,1000)
    cur=con.execute(q); rows=cur.fetchall()
    con.set_progress_handler(None,0)
    return [d[0] for d in cur.description], rows, steps[0]
def ref(con):
    agg=collections.defaultdict(lambda:[0,0]); names={}
    for ctry,gid,gname,up,qty in con.execute("""select i.BillingCountry,t.GenreId,g.Name,il.UnitPrice,il.Quantity
      from Invoice i join InvoiceLine il on il.InvoiceId=i.InvoiceId join Track t on t.TrackId=il.TrackId
      join Genre g on g.GenreId=t.GenreId where i.InvoiceDate>='2021-01-01' and i.InvoiceDate<'2022-01-01' and il.Quantity>0"""):
        a=agg[(ctry,gid)]; a[0]+=round(up*100)*qty; a[1]+=qty; names[gid]=gname
    by=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for (ctry,gid),(r,u) in agg.items(): by[ctry].append((-r,gid,u))
    out=[]
    for ctry in sorted(by):
        for k,(nr,gid,u) in enumerate(sorted(by[ctry])[:2],1): out.append((ctry,gid,names[gid],-nr,u,k))
    return out
ro=sqlite3.connect('file:/inputs/Chinook.sqlite?mode=ro',uri=True)
cols,rows,st=run(ro)
print(cols,len(rows),'steps~',st, rows==ref(ro))
for r in rows: print(r)
print({tuple(type(v).__name__ for v in r) for r in rows})

def copy():
    m=sqlite3.connect(':memory:'); ro.backup(m); return m
# changed quantities
m=copy(); m.execute("update InvoiceLine set Quantity=(InvoiceLineId%5)+1"); 
r=run(m); print('qty change ok', r[1]==ref(m), r[2])
# no sales in period
m=copy(); m.execute("update Invoice set InvoiceDate='2019-06-01 00:00:00' where InvoiceDate<'2022-01-01'")
print('empty', run(m)[1])
# tie: force all prices equal, quantity 1
m=copy(); m.execute("update InvoiceLine set UnitPrice=0.99,Quantity=1"); print('tie ok', run(m)[1]==ref(m))
print(ro.execute("pragma integrity_check").fetchall())
